name: Desert Prophet’s Rod
body:
Price 30,000 gp; Slot none; CL 10th; Weight 10 lbs.; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This long, crooked rod has several abilities that only work in the hands of a good-aligned wielder.

It functions as a rod of the python, but if thrown to the ground it can take the shape of any reptile that can be summoned by summon monster III;.
It has the abilities of an utilitarian rod.
The rod’s crook blooms once per day with whatever non-magical herbs or fruits are most useful for the wielder at the moment (edible fruits if in the desert, wolfsbane if lycanthropes are near, curative herbs if someone is ill or wounded).
Hidden spring 1/day.
Lastly, the wielder can create a purifying spring using the rod. Every creature bathing in the spring’s water is granted the benefits of cleanse. If used this way, the rod is destroyed and permanently loses all its powers.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 15,000 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells Craft Rod, cleanse, fabricate, goodberry, hidden spring, polymorph any object, snake staff
